screens.lore: Local memory: Record keepers copied faded names from an older burial register.
Local memory: Masons saved usable bricks from a dismantled building.
Local memory: Clerks copied a damaged household register by hand.

Local memory: People in Gonlon remember how households agreed on turns at a shared washing place. A trace remains: a washing rota. Local households brush dust from old memorial lettering before a gathering.
